title: Volunteer fatigue shift rotation
summary: A safe rotation for volunteers helping with water, information, cleanup, queues, welfare checks, or transport so exhaustion does not create new emergencies.
content: Core sequence: 1) Set short shifts before people become exhausted, not after mistakes begin. 2) Pair new volunteers with someone who knows the task and the stop rule. 3) Record injuries, heat symptoms, anger, skipped meals, and repeated mistakes as reasons to rotate. 4) End the shift with a handover note instead of leaving the next person to guess.
materials: shift board with start and stop times
water and rest point away from the task
buddy who can stop unsafe effort
